FAQ

Questions? We've got answers.

Does SpaceWise upload my photos or videos?

Scanning and compression are designed to happen on-device, so your media does not need to be uploaded to a server for these operations.

Can I process many files at once?

Yes. Batch Optimizer lets you queue large numbers of supported items and track progress and storage savings.

Can SpaceWise find similar photos, not just exact duplicates?

Yes. On-device computer vision can group near-identical photos so you can review similar shots before deciding what to keep.

What formats can SpaceWise compress?

Supported formats include JPG, HEIC, PNG, WEBP, MP4, MOV, HEVC, MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC, FLAC, and multi-page PDFs.
